statement: Prescription of the link exact rationals -> writePrecision 16 text -> binary64 and of the floating-point operations the pinned OpenFOAM v2406 checkMesh path executes on it. Written before any pull, readback or reader run. It selects no native input, chooses no point of the domain and grants no native admission.

runtime_target.method: docker pull by digest, docker save to a private file outside Git, static read of the layers in Python. No container is created or started, nothing from the image is executed, nothing is deleted.

static_checks.requirement: the saved manifest digest equals identity.image
the image configuration declares os linux and architecture arm64
SHA-256 of checkMesh equals executables.checkMesh; every other pinned executable present in the image matches its pin
checkMesh and libOpenFOAM.so are ELF64 little-endian for machine AArch64 (183)
record the .comment strings of libOpenFOAM.so and checkMesh; compile options are not recorded in the binary and stay inferred from the pinned wmake rules
libOpenFOAM.so imports strtold and __trunctfdf2 (binary128 to binary64 narrowing); absence refuses the S2 model
the 8 bytes of each listed exported constant equal the binary64 rounding of its source literal
libOpenFOAM.so contains the build tag _be01ca78-20240625 and declares label 32 and scalar 64 bits
count FMADD/FMSUB/FNMADD/FNMSUB and vector FMLA/FMLS instructions inside the listed geometry functions; an observation, not an acceptance threshold
record whether the symbol set_fast_math (crtfastmath, flush-to-zero) is present in checkMesh or libOpenFOAM.so
the git blob ids listed in the image META-INFO manifest for the source members read equal the git blob ids of those members in the pinned archive
record SHA-256 and version strings of libc.so.6, libm.so.6, libstdc++.so.6 and libgcc_s.so.1 of the image

runtime_target.not_performed_here: Execution of the pinned binary. The WSL host is x86_64 with no arm64 executor; its amd64 sibling image is a different runtime row and is not run; no emulator is installed or used. Every native behaviour below is a source fact or a static fact until a prescribed execution on linux/arm64 observes it.

facts.literal: constexpr const unsigned bufLen = 128; // Max length for labels/scalars

source_archive.rounding_mode_scan: Scan every .C, .H and .c file under src/ and applications/ of the archive for fesetround, fesetenv, fesetexceptflag, feupdateenv and _FPU_SETCW; record each hit with its path and line.

binary128.role: long double on linux/arm64 (AAPCS64); S2 parses into it

decimal16.style: C printf %.16g: exponent form when the decimal exponent is below -4 or at least 16, trailing zeros and a trailing point removed, exponent with sign and at least two digits

rounding_mode.mode: round to nearest, ties to even, for every binary64 and binary128 operation and conversion
rounding_mode.basis: IEEE 754 default environment; OpenFOAM sigFpe only enables traps (feenableexcept); the archive scan above must find no rounding-mode change on the checkMesh path
rounding_mode.flush_to_zero: assumed off (FPCR.FZ = 0); a static fact only if set_fast_math is absent; otherwise the subnormal results are not covered

constants.gamma: gamma(k) = k*u/(1 - k*u), defined for k*u < 1

stages.where: the generator of any future native input
stages.rule: If r = 0, T = '0'. Otherwise E = floor(log10 |r|); T = sign(r) * round_half_even(|r| * 10^(15 - E)) * 10^(E - 15), written in decimal16 style. T is computed from the exact rational, never through binary64, so no binary64 double rounding enters the text.
branches: exact zero writes '0' and reads through the label branch
a carry to 10^(E+1) is allowed and stays within the bound
an integer-valued T without point or exponent is a label token in S2

stages.where: native ASCII reader, ISstream token then readDouble (source facts token-label-branch, token-scalar-branch, reader-strtold, reader-underflow-to-zero, reader-range-refusal)
stages.rule: If the token has only digits after an optional leading '-' and fits a 32-bit label, x = double(label), exact. Otherwise q = RN128(T) by strtold; if -VSMALL64 <= q <= VSMALL64 then x = +0 (sign of zero and of the value lost); if q < -VGREAT64 or q > VGREAT64 the read fails; else x = RN64(q). VSMALL64 and VGREAT64 are the binary64 roundings of 1e-300 and 1e+300. A token longer than 127 characters fails.
stages.error_bound: for VSMALL64 < |q| <= VGREAT64: |x - T| <= eps_native_read * |T|; in the zero branch |x - T| = |T| <= VSMALL64 * (1 + u128)
branches: double rounding: x may differ from RN64(T) by one unit in the last place when q is a binary64 midpoint and T is not
stages.double_rounding_lemma: If T = D * 10^q with integer |D| < 10^16, q >= -25 and |T| < 2^113, then RN64(RN128(T)) = RN64(T). Proof: a binary64 midpoint M = K * 2^j (K odd, 2^53 <= K < 2^54) differs from T by zero or by at least 1/(2^max(-q,-j) * 5^max(0,-q)); for -q <= 25 this exceeds half a binary128 unit at M because 5^25 < 2^60, so RN128(T) = M only if T = M, and RN128 is monotone and exact on binary64 values. Outside the hypothesis each value is decided by computing both roundings.

stages.where: native writer at writePrecision 16 (OSstream::write(double) is os_ << val; libstdc++ formats with %.*g at precision 16 through glibc printf, correctly rounded under the current rounding mode)
stages.rule: T' = decimal16 rounding of x, ties to even; x = +0 writes '0' and x = -0 writes '-0'
branches: exact tie at the 17th digit, half to even
negative zero written '-0' is read back as +0

chain_budget.first_read: |x1 - r| <= beta * |r| for VSMALL64 < |r| and |r| * (1 + beta) <= VGREAT64
not_identities: 16 significant digits do not guarantee binary64 -> text -> binary64 identity (17 are needed)
16 significant digits do not guarantee text -> binary64 -> text identity (15 are guaranteed)
VSMALL64 itself is written as 1e-300 and read back as 0
chain_budget.more_rewrites: More than one native rewrite needs a new contract revision; it is never absorbed silently.

operation_model.model: fl(a op b) = (a op b)(1 + d) + e with |d| <= u for op in {+, -, *, /, sqrt}; e = 0 for +, - and sqrt; |e| <= eta_underflow for * and / only when the result is below 2^-1022
operation_model.underflow_free_condition: every non-zero coordinate has magnitude in [2^-200, 2^200] and every product in the bounds has at most four coordinate-difference factors; then no product underflows and e = 0
operation_model.theta: products of at most k factors (1 + d_i) are written 1 + theta_k with |theta_k| <= gamma(k)
operation_model.contraction: GCC may contract a product into an adjacent addition (fused multiply-add) on aarch64. Every bound below counts roundings on the unfused evaluation; a fused operation removes one rounding from a path and never adds one, so each bound holds for every contraction pattern. Reassociation (-ffast-math, -fassociative-math) is not covered.
operation_model.exact_conversions: int to binary64 for |n| < 2^53 and multiplication by 0.5 without underflow are exact

operation_bounds.applies_to: faces with n >= 4 points (fan around the computed arithmetic centre c_hat)
operation_bounds.exact_value: A = (1/2) * sum_i p_i x p_(i+1); it does not depend on the fan centre, so the computed centre enters only through rounding
operation_bounds.P_k: sum_i (|a_i,k1 * b_i,k2| + |a_i,k2 * b_i,k1|) with a_i = p_(i+1) - p_i and b_i = c_hat - p_i, exact differences of the binary64 inputs; (k, k1, k2) a cyclic permutation of (x, y, z)
operation_bounds.derivation: each difference carries theta_1, each product theta_1 more, the subtraction theta_1 more (theta_4 per product term); the sequential sum of n terms adds theta_(n-1); gamma(4) + gamma(n-1) + gamma(4)gamma(n-1) <= gamma(n+3); the factor 0.5 is exact

operation_bounds.applies_to: the comparison sumA < ROOTVSMALL64 of faces with n >= 4
operation_bounds.bound: sumA_hat lies in [(1 - gamma(n + 2)) * L, (1 + gamma(n + 2)) * U] with L = sum_i max(0, |n_i| - gamma(4) * ||P_i||_2) and U = sum_i (|n_i| + gamma(4) * ||P_i||_2), n_i = a_i x b_i exact and P_i the vector of the per-component product sums of triangle i

operation_bounds.applies_to: openness_k = |S_k| / (D_k + ROOTVSMALL64) per cell and component, S = sum_f s_f A_hat_f over the m faces of the cell, D_k = sum_f |A_hat_f,k|
operation_bounds.exact_value: sum_f s_f A_f = 0 exactly for a closed cell, for any binary64 coordinates (every directed edge appears twice with opposite orientation); the computed S is not zero in general
operation_bounds.bound: |S_hat_k| <= B_k = sum_f |A_hat_f,k - A_f,k| + gamma(m - 1) * sum_f |A_hat_f,k|; openness_hat_k <= (1 + u)^2 * B_k / ((1 - gamma(m - 1)) * sum_f |A_hat_f,k| + ROOTVSMALL64) / (1 - u)
operation_bounds.decision: decided closed when the upper bound is <= closedThreshold64; the comparison in the source is openness > closedThreshold

operation_bounds.applies_to: openness_k = S_k / (sum_f mag(A_hat_f) + VSMALL64) over the N_b uncoupled boundary faces
operation_bounds.exact_value: sum_f A_f = 0 exactly for a closed boundary surface
operation_bounds.bound: |S_hat_k| <= sum_f |A_hat_f,k - A_f,k| + gamma(N_b - 1) * sum_f |A_hat_f,k|; the denominator is at least (1 - gamma(N_b - 1)) * (1 - gamma(3)) * sum_f |A_hat_f| + VSMALL64 before its own rounding
operation_bounds.decision: decided closed when (1 + u)^2 / (1 - u) * |S_hat_k| bound / denominator bound <= closedThreshold64 for every k

branch_rule.rule: A native comparison value <op> threshold is decided only when the whole interval [value - budget, value + budget] lies on one side of the binary64 threshold (or of the whole threshold bracket when the threshold itself comes from libm). Otherwise it is undecided and retained with its interval and both endpoints. An undecided branch is never resolved by choosing a point, a ratio or a candidate.
branch_rule.equality: equality is resolved by the source comparison operator only when the interval is a single point

native_branches.evaluated_here: reference faces and a certificate-based critical scale

native_branches.comparison: mag(cellVols) > VSMALL64 on the accumulated triple volume before the factor 1/3
native_branches.evaluated_here: no; needs a face-centre conditioning bound

thresholds.rule: pi64 is the binary64 rounding of pi; the two products are binary64 operations; the libm result is not observed here, so the threshold is the bracket of the two binary64 neighbours of the exact cosine of the binary64 argument

certificates.use: domain_v endpoints and the 153 source boxes
the 153 leaves and their endpoints; the undecided determinant leaves
minimum flatness and fan sum lower bounds
recorded ROOTVSMALL, VSMALL and flatness threshold rationals
minimum volume ratio lower bound and recorded threshold

retained.statement: Every box, every endpoint and both undecided determinants are carried unchanged. No point of the domain is selected.

margin_rule.rule: For each native criterion with a pinned certified bound, margin = distance between the certified bound and the binary64 threshold (or the far end of the threshold bracket), computed exactly. A native decision is admissible only when margin > conversion displacement effect + operation rounding budget. The conversion displacement effect needs a sensitivity (Lipschitz) bound of the criterion with respect to point displacement, and the rounding budget needs a conditioning bound of its formula; no pinned certificate provides either, so this revision records margins and the margin expressed in units of u * |threshold|, and decides no native criterion.
inputs_missing: criterion sensitivity to point displacement over the 153 boxes
conditioning of each native formula over the 153 boxes
coordinate magnitude bound R_max of the representation actually written

admissibility_argument.status: documented, not applied; no native input exists or is created here
conditions: the selection rule of any native instance is declared, with its justification from an obligation, before any computation that uses it; a ratio or point chosen because a check passes is refused

the instance lies in boxes where every native criterion is decided by the margin rule including this contract's budgets; boxes 1929 and 1930 stay undecided until a new certificate decides their determinants
every written coordinate is S1 of its exact rational, and the independent reader recomputes every token from the rationals before the native read
every non-zero coordinate satisfies 1e-10 <= |x| (double-rounding lemma) and the underflow-free condition, or the value is decided individually
R_max of the written coordinates is below the critical scale of each guard decided with it
at most one native rewrite at writePrecision 16 between generation and the checked read
the native read, write and checkMesh path is executed by the pinned linux/arm64 binary with its hash verified at launch, under a separately prescribed run

reference_cells.purpose: Synthetic, non-turbo cells that exercise the operation bounds, closure sums and branch rule. They are not a candidate and say nothing about the turbo mesh.
reference_cells.input_path: every coordinate is an exact rational taken through S1 then S2; the operations run on the resulting binary64 values

cells.map: offset + edge * R v, R the rational rotation of the quaternion
offset + edge * v, then vertex 6 moved by edge * (0, 0, 1/10)

block.map: offset + edge * R v over the 3 x 3 x 3 lattice v in {0,1,2}^3

fused_patterns.rule: cross product component k = fma(a_k1, b_k2, -fl(a_k2 * b_k1))
cross product component k = fma(-a_k2, b_k1, fl(a_k1 * b_k2))
F1, and mag(v) = sqrt(fma(x, x, fma(y, y, fl(z * z))))

acceptance: pin: manifest digest, platform and checkMesh SHA-256 equal the runtime matrix row; every other pinned executable present matches
constants: every listed exported constant equals the binary64 rounding of its literal
long-double path: strtold and __trunctfdf2 are imported by libOpenFOAM.so
conversions: primary and independent reader agree bit for bit on every stage of every witness and certificate rational, every stage error lies within its bound, and every witness class is covered
operations: for every reference face and cell and every fused pattern, the computed value lies within its prescribed bound; closure sums are reported as computed
branches: every guard and threshold comparison of the references is classified by the branch rule; undecided ones are retained
certificates: pinned SHA-256 match; 153 boxes, leaves 1778-1930, both domain endpoints and undecided leaves 1929 and 1930 carried unchanged
gate: only G04 changes in the ledger revision and its verdict is the unchanged evaluator's

resource_limits.network: Docker Hub pull of the pinned digest; GitHub release download of the pinned evidence archive
